setup_logging: setup logging with a stream handler and configurable log level via the LOGLEVEL environment variable
run_log_helper: run the log helper module to test debug, info, warning, error, and critical log messages
review_setup_logging: review the setup_logging function to understand how it configures the root logger with a stream handler
refactor_setup_logging: refactor setup_logging to add file logging or custom formatting alongside the existing stream handler
test_setup_logging: test setup_logging by setting the LOGLEVEL environment variable and verifying log output at different levels
